title: Website Speed Impact on Search Ranking
takeaway: Faster websites rank higher in search results, leading to more traffic and visibility.

data.label: Bounce Rate Decrease
data.evidence: A study showed that mobile site speed is the single most influential ranking factor. Specifically, pages that load in 2.6 seconds or slower are 27% less likely to rank on the first page of search results.

data.label: Traffic Loss
data.evidence: A report showed that for every second a page takes to load, a website loses 16% of its potential traffic.

narration: Website speed is a critical ranking factor for local businesses. Studies consistently demonstrate a direct correlation between page load time and search visibility. Slow websites lead to decreased engagement and ultimately, lower rankings.
